mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot supplies the function value at the x-coordinate where the smooth trace has a hole. Right image: The dot includes the left endpoint (−5, 2) in the function graph.
Rationales: The feature specifies an isolated included ordered pair off the nearby curve in the left image and marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the right image. The filled red point at x = 1, above the hollow point on the curve. The filled cyan point at (−5, 2), where the curve ends on the left.
